title: 第十九章 仙道制造第二十章 临界点
content_zh:
晚上。
7点55。
灰核城南区，运河码头旁的商业街。
说是运河，但也是由方舱上层大能用大神通开凿的水道，并非淡水河，可以称为内海。
诸天万界寂灭，天外大星尽毁，最终乐土方舱封闭建筑内终年没有天光，永远处于暗黑之中，所有照明都是人工照明。
岸边望不到运河对面，只有无垠的漆黑。
海水的咸涩、腐烂的水草味，还有一丝若有若无的汽油味，混合在冰冷的雨雾里，每一次吸气都像是在吞咽冰冷的刀片。
脚下的地面泥泞湿滑，阿力心里有些发毛。
“交易地点不是都选在比较偏僻的荒郊野外么，我看这里人挺多的。”
提着手提箱的阿力吐槽着。
箱子里装着五包人粹，一包就管一百五十万，这还是打价格战被极限压价的情况下。
码头商业街，消费者大多为码头工人。
智能芯片，封闭灵脉，都是有产权的，公共区域半丝灵气没有。
只要和大企业签订了终生合同，普通人可以植入灵根，被暴力催熟，义体改造，但退休后得回收修为和义体，普遍短命，收入却要比普通人高很多，干苦力一个月起码有两三万的收入，这种薪资在灰核城才勉强负担得起成家的开支。
街上行走的都是一些粗鄙的力工，也有不少站街的。
这些工人每日重复的刻板行为都只像是保留着劳动本能的野兽，至少在社会认可度上，他们也要比从事一般行业的普通人更强。
医美发达是义体技术的附带红利，妓女懂得投资自己，但岁数装不了，年龄大点的是个体户，年龄小点的都由皮条客统一控制。
一个刚下班身上脏兮兮的集装箱工人不小心肩膀撞到了阿力一下，一只手是粗制滥造发锈有些臃肿的机械臂，让阿力有些犯恶心。
“给老子滚远点。”
阿力本就紧张，一巴掌抽在了这工人脸上，力气不小，给那人扇得踉跄。

灰核城的码头贸易频繁，有不少非法组织走私的，工人瞧了眼面相不善的袁金刚一伙人也没有脾气，叫骂也不敢，灰溜溜走了。
“不长眼睛。”
阿力擦了擦手，从烟盒里取出一支点上，深嘶了一口，前所未有的紧张。
“荒郊野外那是电影里演的，现在检查站和路上无数个摄像头，反而鱼龙混杂的地儿，条子容易丢失目标，萧肃他们已经到了。”
袁金刚眉头紧锁，能不能快速攒到船票的钱，就看今晚了。
他必须趁早偷渡上去，越早越好。
不然那个承诺的效力也会愈来愈淡。
五分钟后。
一行四人抵达了交易地点，挨着商业街不远，一处被搁置的集装箱码头，废弃的集装箱在这里排列成了迷宫。
萧肃早安排了人在外面布控，发现袁金刚他们晃到这里后，让手下将他们接引到迷宫迂回的深处，一个批量运输重型货车的巨大集装箱内，比三层楼房还要更高。
天幕的迷幻灰雾压得极低，将整片码头罩在一片沉郁的阴影里。冰冷的雨水像密集的针，砸在锈蚀的集装箱上，发出沉闷的噼啪声，混着远处河面上隐约的汽笛，织成一张令人窒息的网。
只有一边打开的巨型集装箱内，萧肃一伙人早在这里等待已久。
严重不对等。
袁金刚四人进入集装箱内部，萧肃那边有九人，而且对面那帮人，有一半都是妖族，不是那些被同化了的半妖，保留着百分之八十以上的妖族特征。
炼气境界还没开辟灵识。
但袁金刚的义眼扫描已经判断出，这帮人里面，有三个人都是筑基境界，其中一个甚至是筑基圆满。
当今修真界。
依然是实力为尊，但凭借灵能工业的大火力装备，在灵能反应堆的加持下，越级枪杀已是屡见不鲜的事了。
袁金刚知道自己这边是弱势的一方，在进来前，都是提前拿出了武器的。
阿力还有另外两人，都是端着军用机枪。

对方也不介意，手也都是按在腰间枪上的。
“你就是萧肃？”
袁金刚问向在场境界最高的人。
content_en:
night.
7:55.
In the southern district of Gray Core City, the commercial street next to the canal pier.
It is said to be a canal, but it is also a waterway dug by the powerful powers on the upper level of the shelter. It is not a freshwater river and can be called an inland sea.
All the heavens and all realms are extinguished, and all the stars in the sky are destroyed. In the end, there is no skylight in the closed building of the paradise cabin all year round, and it is always in darkness. All lighting is artificial lighting.
You can't see the other side of the canal from the shore, only endless darkness.
The salty smell of sea water, the smell of rotten aquatic plants, and a faint smell of gasoline are mixed in the cold rain and mist, and every time you inhale is like swallowing a cold blade.
The ground under his feet was muddy and slippery, and Ali felt a little nervous.
"Aren't all trading locations chosen to be in relatively remote wilderness areas? I think there are quite a lot of people here."
Ali, who was holding a suitcase, complained.
There are five packs of human essence in the box, and each pack is worth 1.5 million. This is despite a price war and extreme price reduction.
In the dock commercial street, most of the consumers are dock workers.
Smart chips and closed spiritual veins all have property rights, and there is no trace of spiritual energy in public areas.
As long as they sign a lifetime contract with a big company, ordinary people can have their spiritual roots implanted, be violently ripened, and have their prosthetic bodies transformed. However, they have to recycle their cultivation and prosthetic bodies after retirement. Their lives are generally short-lived, but their income is much higher than that of ordinary people. Working as a coolie can earn at least 20,000 to 30,000 yuan a month. This kind of salary can barely afford the expenses of starting a family in Gray Core City.
The people walking on the street are all rough laborers, and there are also many people standing on the street.
The stereotyped behaviors these workers repeat every day are just like beasts that retain their labor instinct. At least in terms of social recognition, they are stronger than ordinary people engaged in general industries.
The development of medical beauty is a side benefit of prosthetic technology. Prostitutes know how to invest in themselves, but they cannot pretend to be old. The older ones are self-employed, while the younger ones are all under the unified control of pimps.
A dirty container worker who had just gotten off work accidentally bumped into Ali with his shoulder. One of his hands was a crude, rusty and bloated robotic arm, which made Ali feel sick.
"Get away from me."
Ali was already nervous, so he slapped the worker on the face with such force that the man staggered.
The docks of Gray Core City have frequent trade, and there are many illegal smuggling organizations. The workers looked at the unkind-looking Yuan Jinjiang and his group, but they had no temper and did not dare to yell, so they walked away in despair.
"No eyes."
Ali wiped his hands, took out a cigarette from the box, lit it, and took a deep hiss, feeling more nervous than ever.
"The wilderness is like what's shown in movies. Now there are countless cameras at checkpoints and on the road. Instead, it's a mixed bag. It's easy for the cops to lose their target. Xiao Su and the others are already here."
Yuan Jinjiang frowned. It depends on tonight whether he can quickly save the money for the boat ticket.
He had to sneak up there as soon as possible, the sooner the better.
Otherwise, the effectiveness of that promise will become increasingly weak.
Five minutes later.
A group of four people arrived at the trading location. Not far from the commercial street, there was a stranded container terminal, where abandoned containers were arranged in a maze.
Xiao Su had already arranged for people to set up controls outside. After discovering that Yuan Jingang and the others had wandered here, he asked his men to lead them deep into the maze's twists and turns, into a huge container for bulk transportation of heavy trucks, which was taller than a three-story building.
The psychedelic gray fog in the sky was extremely low, casting the entire dock in a gloomy shadow. The cold rain hit the rusted container like dense needles, making a dull crackling sound. Mixed with the faint whistle on the river in the distance, it formed a suffocating net.
In the giant container with only one side open, Xiao Su and his group have been waiting here for a long time.
Serious inequality.
Yuan Jingang and four others entered the container. There were nine people on Xiao Su's side, and half of the group opposite were demons. They were not assimilated half-demon. They retained 100% of the people.Characteristics of demons over eighty.
The realm of refining qi has not yet developed spiritual consciousness.
But Yuan Jingang's prosthetic eye scan has determined that three of these people are in the foundation-building realm, and one of them is even at the foundation-building level.
Today’s world of cultivation.
Strength is still respected, but with the large-scale firepower equipment of the psychic industry and the blessing of the psychic reactor, it is not uncommon for over-level killings to occur.
Yuan Jingang knew that his side was the weak one, so he took out his weapons in advance before entering.
Ali and two others were carrying military machine guns.
The other party didn't mind either, and kept his hand on the gun at his waist.
"Are you Xiao Su?"
Yuan Jingang asked the person with the highest level present.
